calculation.description: Contrarian signal formed from the negative one-day return divided by trailing 10-session volatility, smoothed over the latest three completed sessions. Uses only information available through the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in all tested regimes: 2020-2022 +0.043427 (766 dates), 2023-2024 +0.019801 (516 dates), and 2025-2027 +0.022624 (574 dates). The 1-day horizon is the admission horizon; longer-horizon predictive power decays and turns negative by 10 days.
